evals.prompt: Build an LLM extraction feature whose downstream code requires five typed fields.
evals.expected_output: The skill defines a structured contract and deterministic schema validation before provider-specific code.

evals.prompt: Answer product questions only from our indexed documentation and cite the supporting sources.
evals.expected_output: The skill defines retrieval/source authority, insufficient-evidence behavior, provenance, and evals.

evals.prompt: Add a deterministic REST endpoint with no model inference.
Design the AI feature; OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini libraries are all installed but no provider has been selected.
evals.expected_output: The skill defines capability/contract requirements and does not silently select a provider.

evals.prompt: Evaluate an agent whose output varies across runs and sometimes calls the wrong tool.
evals.expected_output: The skill combines trajectory/tool-state checks with repeated stochastic evals instead of trusting one model-judge score.
